tasks.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (5 Drones) 1
tasks.content: Five-drone coordination exercise: Drone 22, Drone 10, Drone 19, Drone 2, and Drone 3 take off together to 25 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (505, 489, 25), (590, 452, 25), (838, 493, 25), (612, 616, 25), and (383, 662, 25) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all five drones move north for 98m, and next move east for 78m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 98m, then east 78m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
content_aliases: Coordinate Drone 22, Drone 10, Drone 19, Drone 2, and Drone 3: ascend together to 25 meters, establish pentagon formation at positions (505, 489, 25), (590, 452, 25), (838, 493, 25), (612, 616, 25), and (383, 662, 25) respectively, then execute coordinated movement north 98m followed by east 78m. All drones must complete the full directional distance (north 98m, east 78m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Five-drone formation drill: launch Drone 22, Drone 10, Drone 19, Drone 2, and Drone 3 to altitude 25m, hold stations at (505, 489, 25), (590, 452, 25), (838, 493, 25), (612, 616, 25), and (383, 662, 25) respectively, then shift north by 98 meters and east by 78 meters in synchronized operation. Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute synchronized operation with Drone 22, Drone 10, Drone 19, Drone 2, Drone 3: take off reaching 25 meters height, maintain formation at coordinates (505, 489, 25), (590, 452, 25), (838, 493, 25), (612, 616, 25), and (383, 662, 25) respectively, then proceed north for 98m and subsequently east for 78m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.

Five-drone coordinated maneuver: Drone 22, Drone 10, Drone 19, Drone 2, and Drone 3 lift off to 25m elevation, hold formation positions at (505, 489, 25), (590, 452, 25), (838, 493, 25), (612, 616, 25), and (383, 662, 25) respectively, then travel north 98 meters and east 78 meters in sequence. The specified directional distances must be achieved by each drone, adapting position to circumvent any obstacles.
